intent_summary: The adaptive recipe updates each expectation from a bounded window of earlier observations while retaining frozen residual calibration.

criteria.criterion: Each rolling expectation uses only observations before the sample being scored.
Persistent growth changes can be followed more closely than by the frozen default recipe.
An isolated extreme value is held out of future model references rather than creating a seasonal echo.
Conflicting trend choices and slope lookbacks exceeding the adaptive window are rejected.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Inspected rolling window, bounded slope lookback, causal projection and model parameters, plus frozen residual calibration; reviewed persistence admission and isolated-extreme tests.
